description: CORS preflight decision from Fetch spec — Takes a browser request shape (origin, method, headers, credentials flag) and a server CORS policy (allow-origin, allow-methods, allow-headers, allow-credentials, expose-headers, max-age) and returns the exact decision a browser would make per the Fetch Living Standard §3.2 and §4.10: whether a preflight OPTIONS is required, whether the main request is allowed, which response headers the script ca

allowOrigin.description: The Access-Control-Allow-Origin value, as a string ('*' or an origin) or an array of permitted origins the server echoes from.

headers.description: Request headers the main request will send. Names are case-insensitive.

method.description: HTTP method of the main request (not the preflight), e.g. 'POST'.

origin.description: The ASCII serialization of the request's origin, e.g. 'https://app.example.com'. 'null' for opaque origins.

url.description: Target URL, optional. Not used in the Fetch decision; carried through for logging.

withCredentials.description: True if the request uses credentials mode 'include'.

name: cors-preflight
